[Story]
Li Hua is in the library, focusing on reading a book about history, preparing for tomorrow's exam. His good friend Wang Gang sends an urgent message, needing his help to solve a math problem. Li Hua checks the message, but he knows if he leaves now, there may not be enough time to complete his review. At the same time, his teacher happens to come over, reminding him that the library is about to close, and asking him if he needs extra materials to help study.

[Question]
After Li Hua reads the message, what does he do?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He ignores Wang Gang's message and focuses on reading.
B. He asks the teacher to allow him to stay in the library a little longer to help Wang Gang.
C. He asks the teacher for help to solve Wang Gang's math problem together.
D. He leaves the library to help Wang Gang solve the math problem.
